🚌Transport & Logistics DeskMember movements · pickups · fares · coordination
📨 WhatsApp message preview — this is exactly what the Transport Desk receives

Tap a Send button — WhatsApp opens with your request already typed; just press send. The request is also saved to the Movement Board on this device so you can track it.

Need a private ride right now? Yango taxis operate across Lusaka — one tap opens the Yango app on your phone. Yango fares are shown before you ride and are paid directly to Yango, not to the church.
Urgent? Call the lines directly: 📞 0979 554 970 📞 0978 548 813

This board is saved on this device — the Transport Desk can track every pickup, headcount and fare, then copy the summary to WhatsApp for the drivers and coordinators.

🧭 How the Transport Desk works

1Fill the request form — pickup location, number of people, date, time and the fare offered. The message builds itself as you type.
2Send it on WhatsApp to 0979 554 970 or 0978 548 813 — one tap opens WhatsApp with the request already typed. Just press send.
3The Desk confirms the vehicle, fare and pickup time with you on the same number.
4Be at the pickup point 10 minutes early with your group. The driver calls when he is close.

📞 Transport lines

📞 0979 554 970 📞 Call 💬 WhatsApp
📞 0978 548 813 📞 Call 💬 WhatsApp

For funerals and emergencies, please call the line directly instead of waiting for a WhatsApp reply.

🚕 Yango — private rides across Lusaka

🚕 Yango ride-hailing 🌐 Get the app / info

Yango operates in Lusaka, Kitwe, Ndola and Solwezi. Use it when you need a private car quickly — the fare is shown before you ride and is paid directly to Yango, not to the church. For church-organised transport, always use the request form so the Movement Board keeps track of every trip.

📋 Transport guidelines

  • Book early — at least 24 hours ahead for groups of 10 or more.
  • Fares — the fare you enter is your offer; the Desk confirms the final fare with the driver before the trip. Fares are shared fairly among passengers where possible.
  • Priority seating — the elderly, the sick, expectant mothers and children are seated first.
  • Children — under 12 must travel with an adult who remains responsible for them.
  • Instruments & goods — declare them in the notes so the right vehicle is sent (truck / extra space).
  • Keep your phone on — the driver or coordinator will call or WhatsApp to confirm the trip and pickup point.
  • Be on time — vehicles wait a maximum of 10 minutes at the pickup point, so the whole programme keeps flowing.
  • Return trips — tick “Return trip needed” so the Desk schedules the pick-up back as well.
  • Yango — for private rides across Lusaka, tap “🚕 Open Yango App”; those fares are paid directly to Yango, not to the church.
